verdict.rationale: Angular documents components as its core building block (angular-docs-2) and uses TypeScript/JavaScript (angular-gh-1). Community evidence confirms HTML templates can live inside the component (angular-comm-3) and that components are encapsulated (angular-comm-2), so markup and logic can sit together. However, that same feedback says inline string templates lose editor tooling and that Angular's template syntax is non-standard HTML (angular-comm-16), which weakens the 'language I already know' part, and no evidence shows styles bundled in the component. Missing for 10: first-party docs on single-file component authoring, evidence of component-scoped styles, current evidence on template tooling and syntax familiarity.
